items.content: Much like we did with @aisdk, we're bringing a truly open-source, runtime-agnostic solution to harness durability. We're extending the durability infra that powers @eve and Workflows to all harnesses, like Pi and OpenCode. Local, Vercel, or DIY. Fun fact: even Claude Code and Codex can be made durable (and observable!) this way. The catch: they're not (currently) designed for embedding, which makes them less efficient, less portable, and brings an extra sandbox requirement compared to Pi or Fx.

items.content: We migrated https://t.co/ftag8z6AlW with as little intervention as possible, setting out to prove just how much faster @vercel is. ~70% faster builds and ~75% faster paints. We derived two AI skills from the migration that we'll be sharing back. It was a mature workload with a lot of "$formerProvider-isms", and yet the net of the work was done in under a week. If it's [built / rendered / shipped] fast, it's on Vercel.
